## Current dependency correction — October 26, 2026

Network-infra #743 is [closed with its core mitigation verified and its options-tracker-only remainder carried to #846](https://github.com/jvallery/network-infra/issues/743#issuecomment-6404514111). The stale closed prerequisite is removed; #846 is not added as a Verdify blocker. Successful value-free MCP tool/audience audit events are already delivered and visible in Loki.

Remaining work is the actual Verdify client-attribution chain: trace the current Cloudflare tunnel, tier-1 and tier-2 forwarding, identify the trusted transport peer and header stripping/preservation rules, then verify a genuine external client without accepting spoofed forwarded headers. The #743 closure itself does not establish that Verdify receipt. No proxy trust, credentials, routes, logging payload scope or production workload is changed by this correction; the issue remains open for its exact external-client acceptance.


**Estate audit EST-AUD-232**: severity **low**, dimension `observability`, standard [STD-OBS-06](https://github.com/jvallery/agents/blob/main/docs/estate/STANDARDS.md#std-obs-06)

## What needs to change
Emit one structured event per allowed tool call (audience, tool, write/read class, result) and trust X-Forwarded-For/CF-Connecting-IP only from verdify-traefik so the access log shows the real client.

## Why it matters
With a public, token-authenticated MCP that can change setpoints, the success path is the one that needs attribution; denial-only logging cannot answer who changed a plan.

## Evidence (live, 2026-10-19)
kubectl logs on both verdify-mcp pods, last 24h: 7,918 'mcp_transport_authn_denial' and 2 'mcp_tool_authz_denial' JSON events carry audience/tool/reason, but the 627 successful POST /mcp lines are bare uvicorn access lines ('<ip> - POST /mcp 200') with no audience or tool. Source IPs are pod IPs only: 10.42.4.220 (verdify-hermes-iris) and 10.42.4.121/10.42.6.158 (verdify-traefik), so public callers' real addresses are lost (uvicorn runs without --proxy-headers/forwarded-allow-ips). set_plan/set_tunable writes therefore cannot be tied to a caller from logs.

Affected: `k8s:verdify-prod/deployment/verdify-mcp`, `VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform mcp/server.py`, `k8s:verdify-prod/deployment/verdify-traefik`

## Approach
In authorize_tool_call, log an 'mcp_tool_call' event on allow (reuse _TOOL_AUTH_LOGGER, never the token). Start uvicorn with proxy_headers=True and forwarded_allow_ips set to the verdify-traefik pod CIDR or use Traefik access logs with the CF header.

## Alignment with best practice and estate rules
R13; producer lane verdify-platform.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Loki {namespace="verdify-prod",app component mcp} shows mcp_tool_call events with audience and tool for Hermes calls
- [ ] A public test call shows the external client IP, not a verdify-traefik pod IP

<!-- graph-refresh-20261026 -->
## Current dependency correction — October 26, 2026

The signed-artifact software slice remains delivered. Network-infra #555 closed with unresolved UniFi/current-flow and effective-boundary work explicitly carried to [#839](https://github.com/jvallery/network-infra/issues/839); its closure is not passive acceptance of the greenhouse controller's TCP/3232 and TCP/6053 ACL. The native prerequisite now follows #839 for that exact retained output, rather than the whole remaining namespace rollout. [Closure/carry evidence](https://github.com/jvallery/network-infra/issues/555#issuecomment-6403162422).

Actual device ACL evidence, exact reviewed candidate and independently available recovery custody, and any separately attended OTA/password cutover remain incomplete. Device-side signing is still deferred under the recorded decision. This graph correction does not authorize a new ESP32 connection, flash, password change, node cordon or production promotion, and does not release the existing writer reconciliation hold.


## Live state — 2026-10-23

**Signed-artifact software slice deployed and live-verified.** Product PRs #1073/#1074 and encrypted key custody in jvallery/agents#5369 are merged. `verdify-prod-dark` is Synced/Healthy at `0fc5f8b8c94e4d9349090defcdebb265ecd2f418`; the final full non-pruning sync completed all 144 tasks. Both firmware CronJobs remain suspended.

A real isolated build compiled and signed all four outputs. The positive verifier passed signature/byte checks; a private tampered-signature copy was rejected before its main container ran. The deployed builder spec exactly matches the qualified Job. This is signed source/artifact provenance and operator-side verification, not a SLSA-level certification or device-side enforcement; DR-48 remains the recorded device-signing deferral.

**Remaining:** network-infra#77 passive gateway ACL acceptance, then a separately authorized attended OTA/password cutover under #390. No firmware was uploaded, no password rotated, and no extra ESP32 connection was opened. Original Hermes/ingestor Pods remain Ready with zero restarts; final production smoke is 9/9 green. Keep this issue open for the remaining end-to-end criteria.

**Estate audit EST-AUD-225**: severity **medium**, dimension `security-supply-chain`, standard [STD-CI-04](https://github.com/jvallery/agents/blob/main/docs/estate/STANDARDS.md#std-ci-04)

## What needs to change
Make OTA images verifiable end to end. Build from a pinned commit into the artifacts store with a signature and provenance. Flash only an artifact whose signature and SHA match the reviewed build, and have the device itself refuse unsigned images (ESP-IDF signed app verification or Secure Boot v2). Narrow the builder's egress, and restrict OTA tcp/3232 and API tcp/6053 on the device to the named builder and ingestor sources.

## Why it matters
The greenhouse controller drives live plant equipment: heaters, misters, fans and lights. Today, anyone who learns the one static OTA password, or anything that runs in a pod holding it, can push arbitrary firmware from any VLAN that can route to 192.168.10.111, including the home LAN. The builder flashes whatever `main` resolves to at run time, built with internet-fetched toolchain packages, so a bad push to main or a compromised dependency reaches the device with no signature or review step. The archived SHA lists sit on the same writable volume as the binaries, so they cannot prove the flashed image was the reviewed one.

## Evidence (live, 2026-10-19)
2026-10-19 read-only source and live readback, verdify-platform main aa93a521. firmware/greenhouse.yaml protects the device only with `ota: - platform: esphome, password: !secret ota_password` and `api: encryption: key: !secret api_encryption_key`. No esp32 secure_boot, flash-encryption or signed-app-verification option appears anywhere in firmware/. scripts/firmware-rollback.sh line 8-9 says it uses espota2 'to flash an arbitrary .ota.bin over the network', so the device accepts any image presented with the password. scripts/archive-firmware-artifacts.sh writes only sha256 lists (SHA256SUMS, SOURCE_SHA256SUMS, BUILD_SHA256SUMS) on the same RWO PVC verdify-firmware-artifacts; there is no signature or attestation. The CronJob verdify-firmware-builder (deploy/k8s/components/firmware-builder/firmware-builder.yaml) has FW_REVISION default 'main', a mutable branch. It clones with a GitHub token, compiles with ESPHome/PlatformIO packages downloaded at run time, and with FLASH=1 runs `esphome upload` of the binary it just compiled, not a previously archived and reviewed artifact. The same pod holds the OTA password, the device API PSK, the WLAN SSID and passphrase, and the GitHub token. NetworkPolicy allow-firmware-builder-egress allows egress to ipBlock 0.0.0.0/0 with no except, which covers the internet and every LAN VLAN. The original auditor recorded one TCP connect check from the operator Mac (VLAN 40) succeeding on 3232 and 6053; network-infra#42 asks for passive evidence only, so the verifier did not repeat it and the acceptance below requires passive readback. Related open issues: verdify-platform#390 gates releases on behaviour and notes 'live flash bytes were not hashed; the matching archive/provenance directory is absent'. network-infra#42 and #77 cover narrowing the ingestor-to-device 6053 allow. None covers image signing, device-side verification, the mutable-ref flash path or OTA port 3232 reachability.

Affected: `device:greenhouse ESP32 192.168.10.111 (greenhouse.devices.vallery.net) OTA tcp/3232, native API tcp/6053`, `k8s:verdify-prod/cronjob/verdify-firmware-builder`, `k8s:verdify-prod/networkpolicy/allow-firmware-builder-egress`, `k8s:verdify-prod/pvc/verdify-firmware-artifacts`, `k8s:verdify-prod/secret/verdify-firmware-ota`, `k8s:verdify-prod/secret/verdify-app-secrets:ESP32_API_KEY`, `k8s:verdify-prod/secret/verdify-firmware-wifi`, `repo:VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform:firmware/greenhouse.yaml`, `repo:VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform:scripts/firmware-rollback.sh`

## Approach
1) Builder: require FW_REVISION to be a full 40-char SHA (fail on a branch name). Pin PlatformIO platform and package versions in greenhouse.yaml. Split compile and flash into separate Job templates: compile archives firmware.ota.bin plus a cosign signature (sign-blob with a KSOPS-held key, or keyless in-cluster) and an in-toto provenance file. The flash job takes an artifact version, runs `cosign verify-blob` and checks SHA256SUMS before espota2 upload. 2) Device: enable ESP-IDF 'Require signed app images' (CONFIG_SECURE_SIGNED_APPS_NO_SECURE_BOOT with the matching signing key, via esphome esp32 framework sdkconfig_options), so OTA rejects unsigned binaries. Evaluate Secure Boot v2 separately because it is irreversible on the chip, and record the decision. 3) Rotate ota_password after signing is in place, and keep it only in verdify-firmware-ota. 4) Replace the builder egress 0.0.0.0/0 with the registry/GitHub/PlatformIO CIDRs it needs plus 192.168.10.111/32:3232, using `except` for the RFC1918 ranges. 5) Network (network-infra#42/#77): allow 3232/6053 to the device only from the builder and ingestor egress identities, and deny the home and other VLANs. Per network-infra#42, verify passively, not with connect canaries.

## Alignment with best practice and estate rules
NIST SP 800-193 (platform firmware resiliency: authenticated update); NIST IR 8259A device cybersecurity capability 'software update'; ETSI EN 303 645 provision 5.3 (secure software updates); SLSA Build L2 provenance. Estate R14; STD-CI-04.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] The firmware-builder CronJob rejects a non-SHA FW_REVISION, and compile output includes a signature and a provenance file beside SHA256SUMS on the artifacts PVC
- [x] The flash job verifies the signature and refuses an artifact whose signature fails (shown with a harmless tampered fixture, not on the live device)
- [x] firmware/greenhouse.yaml enables signed-app verification, or a recorded Jason decision explains why it is deferred and what compensates
- [x] allow-firmware-builder-egress no longer contains an unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 rule
- [ ] UniFi policy readback shows tcp/3232 and tcp/6053 to 192.168.10.111 allowed only from the named builder and ingestor sources (verified passively per network-infra#42)
- [ ] ota_password rotated after cutover, with a metadata-only receipt

## Dependencies
jvallery/network-infra#42, jvallery/network-infra#77, VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#390


## Decision needed from Jason

Yes. This finding needs Jason's decision or explicit go before execution (data, credentials, exposure, cost or downtime).

_Filed by the 2026-10-19 estate best-practice gap audit. The finding was verified live by an independent re-check. Baseline: [docs/estate/STANDARDS.md](https://github.com/jvallery/agents/blob/main/docs/estate/STANDARDS.md); owner from the estate ownership record (jvallery/agents `registry/policy/estate-ownership/`)._

<!-- planning-status:start -->
## Agent brief (estate re-plan 2026-10-21)
**Goal:** Make greenhouse OTA flashing reviewable and narrow who can reach the device: SHA-only builds with signatures and provenance, narrowed builder egress, OTA/API ports restricted to builder and ingestor, and a rotated OTA password.
**Owner:** VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform | **Phase:** 1 — security | **Priority:** P2 | **Status:** software slice deployed; network and physical cutover pending

### What
- Builder (`deploy/k8s/components/firmware-builder/firmware-builder.yaml`): reject non-SHA FW_REVISION; pin PlatformIO packages in `firmware/greenhouse.yaml`; split compile and flash; compile archives signature and provenance beside SHA256SUMS; flash verifies before espota2.
- Replace `allow-firmware-builder-egress` 0.0.0.0/0 with needed CIDRs plus 192.168.10.111/32:3232 (RFC1918 excepted).
- Network lane (network-infra#77): tcp/3232 from builder only, tcp/6053 from builder and ingestor only; passive verification (network-infra#42).
- Rotate ota_password (value-blind) after the ACL; firmware still flashes.
- Out of scope (deferred by DR-48): device-side signed-app verification and Secure Boot v2.

### Why
- STD-CI-04, R14: the controller drives heaters, misters, fans and lights; any holder of one static password can flash arbitrary firmware today.

**Scheduling rationale:** The approved OTA ACL/password and build-provenance compensations are P2 security phase1. DR-48 explicitly defers device Secure Boot/signed-app verification.

### How
1. PR: builder SHA-only check, package pins, compile/flash split with cosign sign/verify (key in KSOPS), provenance file; test refusal with a tampered fixture (not on the live device).
2. PR: narrow the NetworkPolicy; sync; read back.
3. Coordinate with network-infra#77 for the UniFi ACL; verify passively.
4. Rotate the OTA password in `deploy/k8s/overlays/prod/firmware-ota-secret.sops.yaml`; confirm a builder flash works in an attended window under #390; post a metadata-only receipt.

### Acceptance
- [x] The firmware-builder CronJob rejects a non-SHA FW_REVISION, and compile output includes a signature and a provenance file beside SHA256SUMS on the artifacts PVC
- [x] The flash job verifies the signature and refuses an artifact whose signature fails (shown with a harmless tampered fixture, not on the live device)
- [x] firmware/greenhouse.yaml enables signed-app verification, or a recorded Jason decision explains why it is deferred and what compensates (DR-48, 2026-10-20)
- [x] allow-firmware-builder-egress no longer contains an unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 rule
- [ ] UniFi policy readback shows tcp/3232 and tcp/6053 to 192.168.10.111 allowed only from the named builder and ingestor sources (verified passively per network-infra#42)
- [ ] ota_password rotated after cutover, with a metadata-only receipt; firmware still flashes from the builder after rotation

### Dependencies and blockers
- Blocked by (native, open): [jvallery/network-infra#77](https://github.com/jvallery/network-infra/issues/77)
- Parent: None.
- Open children: None.
- Role: Executable leaf or bounded owner outcome.
- Gates: Preserve the exact current physical/credential/data/recovery gates; remove only approval/process text explicitly superseded by recorded decisions or current direct task authorization.

### Decisions
- Decision (Jason, 2026-10-20, DR-48): Jason deferred device-side signed-app verification and approved compensating controls instead: an OTA-port network ACL limited to the CI/builder source plus OTA password rotation.

### Current review
- Do not expand DR-48 into new permanent signing credentials, device secure-boot changes or a production firmware experiment. Reuse the existing approved credential lane; metadata/source preparation can proceed before the attended exact flash/recovery window.
- Standards: STD-CI-04
- Queue order: security, then DR/backups/durability, then HA/resilience, then product. Native dependencies represent actual prerequisites; this phase policy adds no blanket program blockers.
- This re-plan updates the backlog. Existing execution holds, physical steps and credential/data-custody decisions remain binding; it does not claim implementation or recovery acceptance.

### Evidence and history
- Decision comment: https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/1009#issuecomment-6293627953 (gate:jason removed).
- 2026-10-19: OTA protected only by a static password; builder flashes mutable 'main'; egress 0.0.0.0/0; archive has hashes but no signatures.
- Related: #390 (release gate), network-infra#42, network-infra#43.

- Reviewed against the October 21 issue/owner snapshot and the fleet control-plane estate re-plan (2026-10-21). Live observations are dated and bounded; CI, replica readiness and backup metadata do not prove end-to-end acceptance.

# Qualify lifecycle authority and blinded monitoring in containment

Campaign: #775 · Stage: **C1 — Recovery and integrated physical qualification** · Priority: P1 · Effort: M · Accountable role: Runtime/release lead.

Roles name execution responsibilities and preserve existing assignees. This contract supersedes conflicting historical sequencing; prior comments and receipts remain evidence.

## Current state and next action

October 18 next-ready source cohort published an unchanged-acceptance per-clause map and actual source/role/precondition boundaries. Native prefix pilot remains27/48 UNPROVEN; no additional stateful lifecycle or message experiment was run. The prior ordinary-role installation/authentication and exactly two approved Slack messages remain complete, with original failures and same-attempt reconciliation retained. Feature-off/active emergency nonactuation, locked/armed no-reopen, populated blinding and other named-condition behavior remain unaccepted.

Prior reviewed context: Actual lifecycle/executor authentication and bounded capability denials passed. The named lifecycle packet passed six denials and two admission transitions, then rolled back with all 29 genuine/synthetic rowsets and source/catalog custody unchanged and exactly events +2 across 77 sequences. Ordinary clone password installation and read-only LOGIN are now complete after explicit approval. The separately approved two-message component_experiment_integrity / expired_work_not_terminal route completed on f16a8604/image 53111f35 at 06:51:39 UTC: fire and same-thread resolution, deduplication, alert rollback and one retained cancellation event. Final f46ffe6d reconciliation proves both real sender confirmations, candidate completion and complete typed custody; all 7,950 genuine rows/29 relations and 12,425 alert rows are preserved, with only work events +1 and alert IDs +1 for this phase. Original bridge/release/collector failures remain failed after the second-reply timeout; no retry or resend occurred. The accepted unchanged-source subset is exhausted. Residual feature-off/nonactuation, locked/armed no-reopen, blinding and other named-condition criteria remain open. #641 owns physical recovery/handoff. The newer image is unpromoted; no full issue or full-database/restore acceptance is claimed. Evidence: planning/reviews/2026-10-17-s3-execution/587-lifecycle-authority-proof.md and 587-alert-delivery-proof.md.

Current execution allocation: S3. Next action: Reuse the completed actual-LOGIN lifecycle and one delivered alert pair. Continue the per-clause nonactuation/blinding/named-condition map, joining #783 actual identities and authentic populated data only when legitimately reachable. Do not repeat exhausted denials, create another password route or send another message under the consumed approval.

Execution review: planning/reviews/2026-10-18-execution/README.md. All original acceptance clauses and completion edges remain unchanged.

## What

Qualify lifecycle authority and blinded monitoring in containment

## Why

Lifecycle and monitoring safety require exact actual-role boundaries and native condition/delivery/custody evidence. The expired-work alert and named lifecycle subset are now proven; remaining nonactuation, blinding and authority cases must stay explicit without repeating completed messages.

## How / implementation strategy

1. Reuse the published lifecycle and final named-alert receipts as accepted bounded scope; retain original failed/timeout attempts and consumed credential/message approvals.
2. Reuse the delivered six-clause residual map and update it only from new actual nonactuation, locked/armed, populated-blinding or named-condition proof. Admit genuine source/role/preconditions; avoid duplicate weak tests of the exhausted subset.
3. Prepare only an identified source repair or legitimately reachable missing case; physical full 48-field recovery/handoff stays in #641 and the completed two-message pair is not repeated.

## Source touchpoints

- `experiment_orchestrator`
- `api/main.py`
- `deploy/k8s`
- `db/migrations`
- `tests`

## Dependencies and scope

Parent: #581. Parentage is a roll-up, not a blocking dependency.

No in-repository predecessor. External blockers, when present, are recorded in the current state and reviewed native graph. Pull according to stage priority and the concrete safety/physical conditions below; no blanket human gate is implied.

## Acceptance and validation

- [ ] Feature-off emits no experiment call; illegal readiness/phase transitions and emergency hold cannot actuate.
- [ ] Actual-login lifecycle transitions and rollback pass; no mapping/comparative-result leakage.
- [ ] Named alerts fire, deliver and clear through owning monitoring route; physical full-48 handoff is explicitly owned by #641.

## Delivery and real end-state verification

Deliver the smallest complete owner change, use enforced checks and the existing supported delivery path, then verify the issue-specific end state. Heavy tests/builds run in admitted k3s workloads. Source or CI success does not establish runtime, physical or scientific acceptance.

## Rollback and evidence preservation

Capture prior source/digests/config and data state before mutation. Revert declarative source and verify reconciliation; use forward-safe ledgered DB corrections instead of editing applied migrations. Preserve failed attempts and measurements. Experiment rollback closes exposure/revokes nonbaseline first, then facility-authorized full-48 baseline recovery, two fresh epochs, disable/ID clear and ordinary-writer handoff.

## Decisions / physical boundary

None remains for the completed password installation or consumed two-message pair. Only request a new communication decision if a different concrete message test is necessary; current acceptance does not authorize extra sends.

[Current plan](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/README.md) · [Dependency graph](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Validated source](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/backlog.yaml).

# Complete the bounded AI-admission pilot and publish a decision

Campaign: #775 · Stage: **C2 — Seasonal design lock and randomized start** · Priority: P1 · Effort: L · Accountable role: Research/release lead.

Roles name execution responsibilities and preserve existing assignees. This contract supersedes conflicting historical sequencing; prior comments and receipts remain evidence.

## Current state and next action

The program remains pre-draw. Source selects June 1–July 30, 2027 as the warm 30-pair/60-local-day candidate and a narrow climate-noninferiority plus nine-state burden claim; winter observation is a separate non-treatment study. Current contained actual-role, corrected begin-bundle, lifecycle and one named-alert proofs are accepted within their boundaries. Scientific input qualification, complete current-role integration, successful physical proof, final identity/draw and genuine pilot outcomes remain incomplete. Keep this as a zero-hour roll-up and close only on a completed #785 decision or explicit linked program-stop decision.

Current execution allocation: ROLLUP. Next action: Keep a zero-effort roll-up that links the current child evidence and completed packet versus unfinished issue distinction.

Full review: planning/reviews/2026-10-18-status/README.md. Existing acceptance clauses and actual completion edges are unchanged.

## What

Complete the bounded AI-admission pilot and publish a decision

## Why

The reusable executor/ledger/freezer exists, but low modeled power, hot/dry treatment versus winter calendar and incomplete resource measurement prevent a broad climate-and-efficiency claim.

## How / implementation strategy

1. Maintain a zero-hour roll-up over qualification, scientific input, launch, custody and readout.
2. Preserve the narrow climate-noninferiority plus nine-state burden claim and all failed/null assigned outcomes.
3. Close only on the real #785 decision or a linked explicit stop; add no timed-shadow/A-A/canary/80%-power prerequisites.

## Source touchpoints

- `research/planner-efficacy`
- `experiment_orchestrator`
- `docs/runbooks/experiment-rollout.md`
- `planning`

## Dependencies and scope

Parent: #775. Parentage is a roll-up, not a blocking dependency.

No in-repository predecessor. External blockers, when present, are recorded in the current state and reviewed native graph. Pull according to stage priority and the concrete safety/physical conditions below; no blanket human gate is implied.

## Acceptance and validation

- [ ] All child acceptance has a scoped receipt or explicit stop decision.
- [ ] All assignments, failures and null outcomes retained through final decision.
- [ ] No revived timed shadow, canary, A/A or 80% power prerequisites.

## Delivery and real end-state verification

Close the roll-up only when each in-scope child has its own acceptance receipt or an explicit, linked scope decision. A closed child is evidence of its stated boundary, not proof of a broader product claim.

## Rollback and evidence preservation

Preserve child receipts and closed history. Replan explicitly when evidence fails; do not waive a safety invariant, reopen a locked draw, or call an incomplete campaign complete.

## Decisions / physical boundary

No immediate program decision needed for continued source/measurement work. A later explicit no-go can stop the program without pretending a completed experiment.

## Child deliverables

- [ ] #750 — Recovery/proof campaign: rebaseline current state and seal one safe physical receipt (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #639 — Qualify the component executor, exclusivity and recovery behavior in containment (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #587 — Qualify lifecycle authority and blinded monitoring in containment (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #782 — Finish the empirical inputs and frozen exploratory scientific contract (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #783 — Qualify the complete current-login selector-to-frozen-analysis path (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #588 — Bind exact scientific/runtime identity and finalize one internal draw (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #642 — Activate and verify one randomized day 1 from the locked pilot (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #640 — Freeze and reconcile the first real assigned-day outcome and blinded export (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #784 — Operate the full blinded assigned-day pilot with immutable custody (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #785 — Reveal once, reproduce the frozen analysis and decide the program outcome (open; see recorded disposition)

## Campaign references

[Current plan](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/README.md) · [Dependency graph](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Validated source](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/backlog.yaml).

Original issue bodies and metadata are retained in [the October 17 before-images](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/reviews/2026-10-17-replan/before-open-issues.json) and [the original campaign snapshot](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/archive/2026-09-05/issues.json). Closed issue history and comments remain intact. Planning does not perform a deployment, device change, random draw or experiment launch.

<!-- planning-status:start -->
## Agent brief (estate re-plan 2026-10-21)
**Goal:** Close the AI-admission pilot roll-up only on a completed #785 decision or an explicit linked program-stop decision, with every child carrying a scoped receipt.
**Owner:** VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform | **Phase:** 4 — product | **Priority:** P2 | **Status:** umbrella

### What
- Pre-draw. Candidate window June 1-July 30 2027 (30 pairs / 60 local days); narrow climate-noninferiority plus nine-state burden claim.
- Critical path: #749 readiness, #639/#587 containment -> #641 physical proof -> #782/#783 -> #588 lock/draw -> #642 day 1 -> #640 -> #784 -> #785.
- Out of scope: timed shadow, canary, A/A or 80% power prerequisites (not revived).

### Why
- Low modeled power and incomplete resource measurement rule out a broad climate-and-efficiency claim; the pilot must stay bounded and honest.

**Scheduling rationale:** A new AI-admission pilot is product work. Keep detailed safety/causal gates, but queue P2 phase4 after estate security, DR and HA; previous resume does not place it ahead of these.

### How
1. Zero-hour roll-up: keep child links current; no direct implementation.
2. Close on #785's decision or an explicit stop decision linked here.

### Acceptance
- [ ] All child acceptance has a scoped receipt or explicit stop decision.
- [ ] All assignments, failures and null outcomes retained through final decision.
- [ ] No revived timed shadow, canary, A/A or 80% power prerequisites.
- [ ] (from #750) Fresh source, Argo, runtime and backup receipts identify any remaining mismatch before #749/#641 acceptance is credited (the October 18 packet partly satisfies this).

### Dependencies and blockers
- Blocked by (native, open): None recorded.
- Parent: [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#775](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/775)
- Open children: [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#642](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/642), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#639](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/639), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#587](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/587), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#782](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/782), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#783](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/783), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#588](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/588), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#640](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/640), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#784](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/784), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#785](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/785), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#749](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/749), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#641](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/641)
- Role: Tracking issue: sequence executable leaves by their own phase; membership is not a technical blocker.
- Gates: Preserve the exact current physical/credential/data/recovery gates; remove only approval/process text explicitly superseded by recorded decisions or current direct task authorization.

### Decisions
- Decision (Jason, 2026-10-20, DR-22): Jason formally resumed the campaign; the 2026-10-12 pause handoffs on C-campaign issues are historical, and this pilot roll-up proceeds under its planning-status block with the draw still gated on #749 qualification.
- Consolidation (Jason, 2026-10-20): #750 C1 roll-up closed not planned; #749 and #641 are direct children here.

### Current review

- Standards: Estate operating contract; no new standard exception.
- Queue order: security, then DR/backups/durability, then HA/resilience, then product. Native dependencies represent actual prerequisites; this phase policy adds no blanket program blockers.
- This re-plan updates the backlog. Existing execution holds, physical steps and credential/data-custody decisions remain binding; it does not claim implementation or recovery acceptance.

### Evidence and history
- #750 carry-over: https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/581#issuecomment-6284467100
- 2026-08-14/15 build phase: PRs #589-#603 merged; 2026-08-23 resumption audit; 2026-08-30 sequence moved to #775.

No new all-origin/reverse-conflict/calibration-negative acceptance or physical plumbing/flow/dose/flush commissioning was executed. # Measure realized solar-night dry-out before changing the controller

Campaign: #775 · Stage: **C6 — Evidence-led control and irrigation** · Priority: P1 · Effort: L · Accountable role: Control lead.

Roles name execution responsibilities and preserve existing assignees. This contract supersedes conflicting historical sequencing; prior comments and receipts remain evidence.

## Current state and next action

The installed migration 277 and ordinary-role getter proof remain accepted at their existing boundary; see planning/reviews/2026-10-18-getter-timeout-fix/README.md. The original October 16 window returned zero rows/pending in 11.816649 seconds. October 4 custom/generic calls returned the same four 46-column rows in 11.269874/4.966761 seconds: two complete/ineffective and two incomplete/insufficient-evidence, none effective. These are installed-production timings within the unchanged 15-second fence; the 3.174204-second clone result is not a production timing. Original failures, twenty native full-row parity fixtures, 2,673 genuine clone readback relations, installed ledger/seal/receipt and prior runtime evidence remain unchanged.

A new single bounded read-only assessment of the complete selected stored input found incomplete recorded solar-day coverage on both dates. October 16 has 644 of 669 valid recorded minutes, 25 missing clock buckets, zero known held-admission minutes and 12 ordinary dehumidification minutes. October 17 has 643 of 666, 23 missing clock buckets, zero known held-admission minutes and 2 ordinary dehumidification minutes. The 48 missing clock buckets are not interpolated or counted twice across climate/action records. Complete-recorded-daytime measured-zero remains NULL on both dates; no historical row was changed and continuous physical absence is not proved.

The optional default-off Iris scorecard reader from b814f35e is delivered at MCP digest ae8a367035a3ae8a06ab2384bc166f444b3decad0da21e5c70e53e76203d9c73. An explicit solar-night start date requests one bounded existing-getter read, preserving all 46 fields, NULLs, dispositions and confounds under the 500-episode/64-KiB limit. Iris retains 23 tools and outcome_kpi remains admin-only. The source-owned SOUL/inventory refresh is accepted; it requests prior-completed-night ordinary SUNRISE/SUNSET use.

The separately authorized GPT-6 Luna/xhigh profile and truthful API label are delivered from source 56b316f3fda666b25665dfc0f791d6be6db0fa46. The profile is 2261f5c1a236202b3bfccedd82f1284f50ab27445767dcb09439a92a8d58b56b; installed prompt/playbook/inventory prose remains unchanged, including legacy model-name text. No new natural cycle was launched; natural-cycle cost and the 20% comparison baseline remain unknown.

Two actual bounded ordinary-consumer cases passed using GPT-6 Luna/xhigh over Responses and the existing Iris audience. October 4 returned the same four complete 46-field rows as the prior installed-production custom read: two ineffective and two insufficient-evidence, none effective. October 16 returned no episodes, pending safety and NULL daytime counts. There were exactly 2 authenticated scorecard reads and 4 provider requests, using 818 output tokens in total, with no other tools dispatched or retries. The fixed structured scope statement and actual counts/NULLs passed; this is forced, bounded evidence consumption, not autonomous tool selection or a full Hermes gateway cycle.

Current execution allocation: S3B follow-up. Next action: Define a supported observation/freshness contract and collect a prospective complete recorded daytime window; preserve the incomplete October 16/17 history. Observe intended outcome consumption in a naturally scheduled ordinary planner cycle, separately from the accepted bounded read/model qualification. Measure that new cycle before comparing cost. Reuse the installed getter and accepted delivery; keep physical efficacy, crop sensing and crop safety on their own evidence.

Full #410 remains open: bounded source, runtime, ordinary read and model interpretation do not prove a natural planner cycle, complete daytime observation or physical efficacy.

Evidence: planning/reviews/2026-10-18-daytime-consumer/README.md. All acceptance clauses, states, parents, dependencies and original estimates remain unchanged.

## What

Deliver validity-bearing solar-night moisture-removal episodes and a measured effective/ineffective/blocked/insufficient-evidence disposition.

## Why

Projected gain, a fixed clock window and a few favorable nights cannot establish reliable greenhouse-wide dry-out or justify a Vanda watering program.

## How / implementation strategy

1. Reuse installed migration 277 and its native parity, ledger/seal/receipt and ordinary-role evidence. Preserve original failures, all 46 values, NULL/tie behavior, helper cardinality and solar/response semantics; do not repeat the completed repair to claim broader acceptance.
2. Use the existing Iris-authorized scorecard opt-in with one explicit prior completed solar-night start date. Preserve the default false cost boundary, 500-episode/64-KiB refusal bounds, current timeout and explicit unavailable/pending states. Keep outcome_kpi admin-only and all existing audiences and identities unchanged; an unavailable admin identity is not a prerequisite for this ordinary-reader route.
3. Retain the complete bounded daytime assessment as incomplete: zero known held admission among observed records does not fill the 48 missing clock buckets. Define the observation/freshness contract for a prospectively collected complete recorded window; preserve ordinary daytime dehumidification and all solar, heat2, wind/dwell and temperature safeguards.
4. Reuse accepted actual Iris HTTP, source-owned Hermes refresh and separately bounded GPT-6 Luna interpretation. Observe a naturally scheduled ordinary-planner cycle separately and measure its cost before comparing. Preserve the distinction between safety, efficacy, incomplete coverage and crop safety; no universal VPD target or tuning follows.

## Source touchpoints

- `db/migrations`
- `firmware`
- `research/planner-efficacy`
- `mcp`
- `scripts`

## Dependencies and scope

Parent: #359. Parentage is a roll-up, not a blocking dependency.

Predecessor records: #371 (closed), #419 (closed), #424 (closed). Open records gate the stated bounded deliverable; closed records retain their original disposition and are not active blockers. Preparation may proceed earlier.

## Acceptance and validation

- [x] Episodes use device solar semantics, never fixed 02:00–06:00, and incomplete/confounded episodes cannot be PASS.
- [ ] Solar-day held-temperature admission is zero while ordinary daytime dehumidification remains correctly distinguished.
- [x] Planner/MCP sees realized validity-bearing outcomes and explicit disposition, not a universal VPD target or a crop-safety claim without sensing.

## Delivery and real end-state verification

Deliver the smallest complete owner change, use enforced checks and the existing supported delivery path, then verify the issue-specific end state. Heavy tests/builds run in admitted k3s workloads. Source or CI success does not establish runtime, physical or scientific acceptance.

## Rollback and evidence preservation

Keep original extraction and definitions immutable; supersede with a new version and compare hashes. Never rewrite locked assignments, outcomes or an earlier analysis to improve a result.

## Decisions / physical boundary

The existing Iris scorecard audience and user-authorized model export/upgrade have delivered the bounded ordinary-consumer path. No new credential or admin audience is needed. Full #410 stays open for prospective complete observation, natural use and physical/control evidence; do not repeat accepted delivery or infer missing historical values.

## Campaign references

[Current plan](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/README.md) · [Dependency graph](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Validated source](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/backlog.yaml).

### Why
- A tuned field silently using a compiled default creates false parity or divergence; coverage limits must be explicit.

**Scheduling rationale:** - A tuned field silently using a compiled default creates false parity or divergence; coverage limits must be explicit. Product sequencing remains phase4 after the three core concerns.

### How
1. Do nothing until one concrete oracle question is selected and recorded here.
2. Then generate the matrix from `firmware/test/replay_emit.cpp` (REPLAY_EMIT_REQUIRE_FULL_SETPOINTS) and `scripts/export-replay-overrides.sh`; reuse #639's consumer classification.

- [ ] No twin result can qualify full current 48-field physical exposure or new transport by default.

issues.body:
# Hardware program: commission only the sensing and equipment justified by evidence

Campaign: #775 · Stage: **C7 — Physical and seasonal commissioning** · Priority: P2 · Effort: L · Accountable role: Operator with data/control lead.

Roles name execution responsibilities and preserve existing assignees. This contract supersedes conflicting historical sequencing; prior comments and receipts remain evidence.

## Current state and next action

Full issue review, October 18, 2026. Delivery state: ROLLUP INCOMPLETE.

Completed or retained scope: The hardware program is narrowed to evidence-backed sensing and finite seasonal/equipment decisions. Center-fertilizer and automatic motorized-shade premises are not current mandatory scope. Physical identity and commissioning remain unverified. Current config still contains Canna Lily, unknown seedlings and Unknown pots; those are configuration assumptions, not present-day observations.

Remaining actual acceptance: Each physical item has a named measurement/control need, commissioning worksheet and explicit enabled/disabled state.; No center-fertilizer path contradicts #434; absent sensors are not synthesized as real observations.; Operator windows and seasonal triggers are tracked without guessed dates or blanket launch blockers.

Evidence and limits: https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/16 · https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/83e148b60948d0c2328f8a22d819d481ff2c4ca6/config/zones.yaml · https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/83e148b60948d0c2328f8a22d819d481ff2c4ca6/planning/reviews/2026-10-17/ISSUE-TRIAGE.md

See planning/reviews/2026-10-18-status/README.md and issue-status.json for current ownership, bounded preparation, dependencies and dated evidence. No full-issue acceptance is inferred from a partial receipt.

Current execution allocation: ROLLUP. Next action: Maintain child results for #751/#298/#51/#52/#412 and #298→#398→#45. Reuse one field inventory and record enabled/disabled/uncommissioned states for each selected item.

Full review: planning/reviews/2026-10-18-status/README.md. Existing acceptance clauses and actual completion edges are unchanged.

## What

Maintain a prioritized physical inventory and commissioning backlog, separating required measurements from optional equipment and superseded plumbing ideas.

## Why

Historical hardware lists include a center fertilizer mister that conflicts with the later approved center-climate-only/wall-fertigation policy. Missing center, PAR, soil and gas evidence also limits claims.

## How / implementation strategy

1. Roll up #298/#751/#51/#52/#412 and the #398→#45 commissioning chain without adding estimated work or a blanket pilot dependency. Ask for one field inventory when the physical window is scheduled, not separate redundant inventories.
2. Prepare optional center air sensing, PAR calibration, reference CO2, runoff/feed EC/pH, non-overhead night humidity and HAF proposals with quantified evidence gaps and safety/maintenance tradeoffs.
3. Keep motorized shade dropped unless explicitly reconsidered; retire the historical center-fertilizer install premise in favor of #434. No purchase/install is a pilot prerequisite without a specific demonstrated need.

## Source touchpoints

- `config`
- `firmware`
- `docs`
- `planning`

## Dependencies and scope

Parent: #775. Parentage is a roll-up, not a blocking dependency.

No in-repository predecessor. External blockers, when present, are recorded in the current state and reviewed native graph. Pull according to stage priority and the concrete safety/physical conditions below; no blanket human gate is implied.

## Acceptance and validation

- [ ] Each physical item has a named measurement/control need, commissioning worksheet and explicit enabled/disabled state.
- [ ] No center-fertilizer path contradicts #434; absent sensors are not synthesized as real observations.
- [ ] Operator windows and seasonal triggers are tracked without guessed dates or blanket launch blockers.

## Delivery and real end-state verification

Close the roll-up only when each in-scope child has its own acceptance receipt or an explicit, linked scope decision. A closed child is evidence of its stated boundary, not proof of a broader product claim.

## Rollback and evidence preservation

Preserve child receipts and closed history. Replan explicitly when evidence fails; do not waive a safety invariant, reopen a locked draw, or call an incomplete campaign complete.

## Decisions / physical boundary

None beyond normal scoped delivery; this planning campaign authorizes no physical experiment or OTA.

## Child deliverables

- [ ] #751 — Replace the failed south climate probe and diagnose hydro telemetry in a bounded window (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #298 — Rebaseline actual crop, pot and probe topology before feedback control (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #398 — Replace stale soil threshold seeds with commissioned crop/substrate truth (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #45 — Commission soil and runoff feedback before enabling irrigation decisions (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #51 — Calibrate CO2 against a real reference and publish measurement uncertainty (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #52 — Define species-appropriate seasonal dormancy care from operator observations (open; see recorded disposition)
- [ ] #412 — Close the seasonal door screen only when measured night conditions justify it (open; see recorded disposition)

## Campaign references

[Current plan](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/README.md) · [Dependency graph](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Validated source](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/backlog.yaml).

Original issue bodies and metadata are retained in [the October 17 before-images](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/reviews/2026-10-17-replan/before-open-issues.json) and [the original campaign snapshot](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/main/planning/archive/2026-09-05/issues.json). Closed issue history and comments remain intact. Planning does not perform a deployment, device change, random draw or experiment launch.

<!-- planning-status:start -->
## Agent brief (estate re-plan 2026-10-21)
**Goal:** Keep the C7 hardware roll-up current until every child (#751, #298, #398, #45, #51, #52, #412) is accepted or explicitly disabled/not-planned, with each physical item's need, worksheet and enabled/disabled state recorded.
**Owner:** VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform | **Phase:** 3 — resilience | **Priority:** P2 | **Status:** umbrella

### What
- Roll-up only: no direct implementation; progress is the children's receipts.
- Scope is evidence-backed sensing plus finite seasonal/equipment decisions. Center-fertilizer and automatic motorized shade are out of scope (not current mandatory scope).
- Physical identity comes from the shared #298 field survey; config seeds (Canna Lily, Unknown pots, unknown seedlings in `config/zones.yaml`) are assumptions, not observations.
- Greenhouse devices are recorded in verdify-platform; HA device-authority rows stay in jvallery/homeassistant (D-06).

### Why
- Uncommissioned sensors or plumbing must never be treated as real observations or enable feedback/fertigation (R22).
- The #298 survey unblocks #398 -> #45 -> #297 and the #52/#412 seasonal decisions.

**Scheduling rationale:** - Uncommissioned sensors or plumbing must never be treated as real observations or enable feedback/fertigation (R22). - The #298 survey unblocks #398 -> #45 -> #297 and the #52/#412 seasonal decisions.

### How
1. Drive the shared #298 field survey first (schedule with Jason per DR-45 revised); reuse one worksheet for #298/#52/#412/#751.
2. As each child lands, record per-item need, worksheet link and enabled/disabled/uncommissioned state in this issue (or `planning/backlog.yaml`).
3. Confirm no center-fertilizer path contradicts #434 (grep `firmware/greenhouse/controls.yaml` for fertilizer routing).
4. Close when all children are closed with receipts or explicit not-planned decisions.

### Acceptance
- [ ] Each physical item has a named measurement/control need, commissioning worksheet and explicit enabled/disabled state.
- [ ] No center-fertilizer path contradicts #434; absent sensors are not synthesized as real observations.
- [ ] Operator windows and seasonal triggers are tracked without guessed dates or blanket launch blockers.

### Dependencies and blockers
- Blocked by (native, open): None recorded.
- Parent: [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#775](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/775)
- Open children: [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#751](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/751), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#298](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/298), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#398](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/398), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#45](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/45), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#51](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/51), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#52](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/52), [VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#412](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/412)
- Role: Tracking issue: sequence executable leaves by their own phase; membership is not a technical blocker.
- Gates: Preserve the exact current physical/credential/data/recovery gates; remove only approval/process text explicitly superseded by recorded decisions or current direct task authorization.

### Decisions
- DR-22 (Jason, 2026-10-20): the greenhouse campaign is formally resumed. The 2026-10-12 'PAUSED; do not auto-resume' handoff is historical and is not a hold. The pilot draw stays gated on #749 qualification.
- DR-45 revised (Jason, 2026-10-20): Jason can make the attended greenhouse visit; only a reference CO2 sensor is missing. Schedule the #298 field survey with Jason. Physical-work priorities (#298, #398, #45, #297, #52, #412) stay as they are. This supersedes the earlier 2026-10-20 'no attended visit planned' comment.
- Estate consolidation (Jason, 2026-10-20): umbrellas track members only as native sub-issues and carry the highest open child's priority (estate README §4.3).
- D-06 (Jason, 2026-10-19): device authority is per lane; greenhouse devices stay with verdify-platform, HA device rows with jvallery/homeassistant.

### Current review
- Reconciled the current scope, native prerequisites, acceptance and owner evidence with the security-first queue.
- Standards: Estate operating contract; no new standard exception.
- Queue order: security, then DR/backups/durability, then HA/resilience, then product. Native dependencies represent actual prerequisites; this phase policy adds no blanket program blockers.
- This re-plan updates the backlog. Existing execution holds, physical steps and credential/data-custody decisions remain binding; it does not claim implementation or recovery acceptance.

### Evidence and history
- Full review 2026-10-18: `planning/reviews/2026-10-18-status/README.md`. ROLLUP INCOMPLETE; 0/3 clauses proven (2026-10-05, 2026-10-06 reviews).
- Config evidence: https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/83e148b60948d0c2328f8a22d819d481ff2c4ca6/config/zones.yaml
- Resume note: https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/issues/16#issuecomment-6293603179. 2026-10-12 pause handoff: historical (DR-22).
- Priority raised P2 -> P1 in this pass because child #45 is P1 (umbrella rule).

- Reviewed against the October 21 issue/owner snapshot and the fleet control-plane estate re-plan (2026-10-21). Live observations are dated and bounded; CI, replica readiness and backup metadata do not prove end-to-end acceptance.
